turns.query: A planning desk wants a land-use regression for NO2 across our eighteen stations, to screen unmonitored sites and to quote the effect of industrial land in a submission. Fit the specification the desk has fixed and report how well it fits and what it says the roadside location adds.

Before interpreting the industrial term, report its fitted coefficient and leave-one-station-out range. Identify any station whose removal reverses its sign and the most stable predictor. What do these diagnostics establish about a causal industrial-emission effect?

Inspect the industrial polygons near the influential station: report their count and land-use identity. Would holding out whole stations in cross-validation resolve the industrial interpretation? Recommend what the desk should verify before making a source-effect claim.
